articles.headline: NVIDIA Announces Jetson Orin Nano 2 Robotics Computer to Redefine Entry-Level Edge AI
articles.description: NVIDIA today announced NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano™ 2, a new robotics computer set to redefine entry-level edge AI — putting frontier-class generative AI performance in the hands of millions of developers.

China's humanoid robots are stealing the show, but a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
articles.description: There are more than two million robots working in China's factories - and they are scaling up fast.

articles.headline: Report: Amazon eyes ‘fully automated’ delivery stations to bring robotics to the last mile
articles.description: Amazon is developing an internal initiative called Project Tetromino to build "fully automated" delivery stations, according to an internal planning document obtained by Business Insider. The effort could rely on technology from Boxbot, a robotics startup that uses AI-driven storage trays to sequence packages for vehicle loading.

articles.headline: BlackBerry CEO says robotics is one of its fastest-growing businesses
articles.description: BlackBerry CEO John Giamatteo says robotics is one of QNX’s fastest-growing businesses as the company expands its software beyond cars.

articles.headline: 3 Key Takeaways From Bill Gates' Stark Warning About AI and Jobs
articles.description: Bill Gates warned in a new essay that a coming robotics boom could reshape construction, hospitality, and the social contract.

articles.headline: What Is Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) Looking For In Humanoid Robotics?
articles.description: Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) has joined Alibaba as a lead investor in Xpeng's humanoid robotics spin out Dogotix, backing a US$900 million funding round. The deal marks Tencent's entry into a standalone humanoid robotics venture outside its existing software, platform and cloud operations. Tencent's move highlights growing interest from large Chinese tech companies in AI enabled hardware and robotics projects. articles.headline: Qualcomm Launches Comprehensive Robotics Investment Initiative in Japan, Anchored by New Qualcomm Japan Robotics Center
articles.description: Qualcomm has launched a robotics investment initiative in Japan, anchored by the new Qualcomm Japan Robotics Center. Working with leading robotics, automation, research, and technology organizations, the initiative aims to advance an open physical AI ecosystem through innovation, ecosystem development, commercialization, and deployment, helping accelerate next-generation robotics solutions in Japan and globally.
